Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes, reporting neck pain,
stiffness, and headache consistent with whiplash-type mechanism. Across four visits, the patient was managed with a standard
conservative course including range-of-motion exercises, manual therapy, and home stretching guidance. Imaging and
examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury to the cervical region, with restricted rotation and tenderness on
palpation. The patient reports no prior injury to the neck or upper back, and none is known from available records. Treatment
followed a usual trajectory, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms imrpoved and function returned. Billing records show no
repeated chrages for the same services. Whether the present symptoms are fully attributable to this collision remains unclear and
will be reassessed at follow-up.

  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
